errors.uploadNetwork: Couldn't upload the file. Check your connection and try again.
errors.uploadType: Only photos (JPG, PNG, WebP) and PDF documents are allowed.

schedules.title: Scheduled services
schedules.note: What each vehicle has left until its next service; most urgent first
schedules.empty: No vehicle has a service plan yet. Create one in “Plans” (for example, an oil change every 5,000 km) and apply it to your vehicles.
schedules.fixLastTitle: Correct when it was last done
schedules.hasOrder: It already has an unfinished work order

expiries.title: Expirations
expiries.note: Insurance, technical inspection, registration, license and anything else that expires
expiries.empty: No expirations recorded. Add the date of the insurance or the technical inspection and we'll let you know before it expires.
expiries.removeBody: The “{{what}}” expiration of {{vehicle}} is deleted and stops warning.

baseline.numbers: The odometer and hours are numbers, without letters.
baseline.lead: When this service was last done. What's left until the next one is counted from there.

expiry.warnRange: Days of notice go from 0 to 365.
expiry.detailPlaceholder: Policy number, whose license it is…
expiry.warnDays: Notify this many days in advance

settings.title: Maintenance notifications
settings.lead: When a service is coming up or already due, and when a document is about to expire, the notification shows up among the vehicle's alerts.
settings.who: Who gets notified, and through which channel, is set in Administration → Notifications.
settings.currencyNote: It's the one suggested on each work order; it can be changed on each one.

orders.title: Work orders
orders.lead: Preventive services and repairs, with their labor and parts
orders.emptyManage: No work orders to show. Create one to record a service or a repair.

order.numbers: Labor, odometer and hours are numbers, without letters.
order.checkPart: Check the quantity and cost of “{{name}}”.
order.doneBeforeOpened: The completion date can't be earlier than the opening date.
order.title: Work order no. {{n}}
order.workPlaceholder: Oil change, brake pads, checking a leak…
order.odometerHint: Empty: the vehicle's odometer when it's completed.
order.fromCatalog: Add a part from the catalog
order.noFiles: No files. You can keep the invoice or photos of the work here (JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF).
order.attachLater: Once it's saved, you can attach the invoice or photos of the work.
order.restartsSchedule: When it's saved as completed, the count for that scheduled service starts over from this date and this odometer.
order.confirmDelete: The work order and its attachments will be deleted. This can't be undone.
order.confirmDeleteFile: “{{name}}” is deleted from the work order. This can't be undone.

plans.title: Service plans
plans.note: Each plan is due at whatever comes first: kilometers, engine hours or time
plans.emptyManage: No plans yet. Start with the oil change: there's a template with the usual values, which you can adjust to your fleet.
plans.wholeNumbers: They're whole numbers, without letters or decimals.
plans.needInterval: Say how often it's due: kilometers, engine hours or days.
plans.intervalZero: “How often” must be more than zero.
plans.interval: How often it's due; whatever comes first. Leave empty what doesn't apply
plans.noVehicles: You don't have any vehicles yet.
plans.joinNote: A vehicle that joins the plan is counted from today, with its current odometer. If its last service was earlier, correct it in “Pending”.
plans.confirmDelete: The plan will be deleted and stop counting for its vehicles. Work orders already done are kept.

catalogs.workshopsNote: Where the work is done and who the parts are bought from
catalogs.partsNote: What's used in work orders, with its reference cost
catalogs.noParts: No parts yet. The ones you add can be chosen when filling in a work order.
catalogs.partNumbers: Cost and stock are numbers, without letters.
catalogs.stockNote: If you record the stock, it goes down by itself when a work order that uses this part is completed. Empty: not tracked.
catalogs.confirmDeleteWorkshop: It is deleted from the catalog. The work orders it appears in are kept, but without it.
catalogs.confirmDeletePart: It is deleted from the catalog. The work orders that used it still show it by name.
